notes.title: When The Past Was Around x Makeship Collaboration - Eda and Owl Plush!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/8545c0b0e07b63a64d6614944e37ac059e0170d6.png[/img]

Greetings, fellow lovebirds. 

The final journey of finding one's true self together with your beloved is what we all want. It's the same with Eda and Owl, who have their love story that you can't ever forget. The silent yet remarkable tale shows us that we might be lost, but there's special someone that always helps us around our way. A mundane story about love, dreams, passion, and relationship which everyone might encounter, it's no different with Eda and Owl. 

We proudly present our collaboration campaign with Makeship, where a set of plushes, Eda and Owl, can be brought back home with you.

[h1]The cheerful Eda in pursuit of her muse[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/48c6b6cbf32af5c0775c2b1a7bb3d812f9608cc4.png[/img]

[i]Like everyone else, Eda is just an ordinary girl with dreams to achieve and sometimes can be lost in her journey.[/i]

[h2]Let's have a closer look at the Eda plush~[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/4d88ae4dac2a53b29f9df20b8ecb58e0ab930f4c.png[/img]
[i]Eda is wearing her signature gown, adorned with a single white jasmine flower on her head. [/i]

[h3]A young girl who dreams dearly of the future and finding her one true love, Eda always tries her best to obtain what she wants.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/d991dfe1e2e25566567f926ff648a4b738aae546.jpg[/img]
[i]Bring the Eda plush anywhere with you, as she will be there to accompany your everyday life. [/i]

[h1]The tender Mr. Owl who soothes his lover[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/81599fdf6d91b8b0c4ddec48234eb6dd3d77bf79.png[/img]
[i]Whether in good or difficult times, sickness or health, the quirky Owl is always there for Eda.[/i]

[h2]Let's have a closer look at the Owl plush~[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/82597b4cdc5422875a3c69449fe08a7e9d05f3a9.png[/img]
[i]Mr. Owl donned his casual clothing with a white scarf that made him stand out the most. [/i]

[h3]Owl is a peculiar person who appears and brings new colors to anyone around him, someone you won't easily forget. [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/1736a8e7eb8e90397cc65e644e628c76faf592e1.jpg[/img]
[i]Mr. Owl can be your escort, but don't forget to take a break and play music with him.[/i]

[h3]Outside in the nearby park, you might spot them having a nice picnic. [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/7757c28f675cbc3097f0d2b48b8da2ce8656b499.jpg[/img]
[i]You can bring them home as a set, as they are inseparable wherever they go. [/i]

[h3]Receive an additional discount when you take back them both as a set~[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/e2c61f79e2610bc72a8a08d9bc38ef235c5431e5.jpg[/img]
[i]Reliving the scene where Eda and Owl play their instruments together. The playful Owl and the timid Eda sometimes can misunderstand each other.  [/i]

[h3]Are you ready to bring this adorable plush with you?[/h3]
If you are interested, you can pre-order your favorite plush right now, or you can bring Eda and Owl plush as a set.  

[h2][url=https://shop.makeship.com/3S9ja5q]Eda and Owl Plush Campaign page[/url][/h2]

[b]The campaign starts from September 22nd, 2022, to October 13th, 2022.[/b] An exclusive collaboration with Makeship that won't come twice. [b]For this campaign to succeed, we need at least 200 orders for each plush[/b]. We would be incredibly pleased if you could be one of the campaign's backers. 

Eda and Owl plush can be your new friends in your daily life when there are tasks to do or taking a rest with a nice cup of tea. Eda and Owl plush campaign is[b] a one-time collaboration that can only be pre-ordered during this period.[/b] Unfortunately, when the campaign ends, there is no other way to get the plush officially. Let's take part together with all of us in this not-to-be-missed opportunity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/66643bb8ae0e6f02ad52c182224d9ae014d39591.png[/img]

notes.title: Happy White Day from When the Past was Around!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/2b7cb3918c5cd66b52df5c625a46afe2a58cff19.png[/img]

[h2]Happy White Day 2022![/h2]

Greetings, fellow lovebirds.

We wish you a wonderful White Day, may your efforts are paid off to the one you love!

On March 14, you may have this warm experience when you can return the love from Valentine's Day, exactly a month before. This wonderful event is often celebrated in Asian countries such as Japan, Taiwan, and South Korea. If you received something from Valentine's Day, you need to return the feelings back during White Day.

Isn't it just sweet to receive back the feelings you gave out after mustering up the courage to do so?

We also want to respond back to all of the love that When The Past Was Around has received. In the game, this is the part where Mr. Owl will try to respond to his feelings to Eda as someone who he cherished the most. White Day event is not limited to couple, you can also celebrate it with your friends and families alike.

[h2]Free Wallpapers for Desktop and Mobile Users! [/h2]

Feel free to download the wallpaper we made especially for White Day. There are a few variations of wallpapers in high resolution you can choose from, both for desktop and mobile users.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/f6c2b1eff65b60faff533840943af75cb3096556.png[/img]
One of the wallpapers available, Mr. Owl and Eda in a collage of photo frames. 

You can [url=http://bit.ly/wpwa-wallpaper ]get the wallpapers directly here[/url] and choose which one you prefer to download. You can also download all of them, just in case you might need it one day.

All of the charming wallpapers were made by [url=https://twitter.com/crystalnyam]Brigitta Rena[/url], who also happened to have a livestream with us! Check out Lala together with Rena on Toge Productions Youtube channel as they were drawing and discussing fun topics together~

Don't forget to subscribe to [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaJfdsJDP_vzVl-Sl1x0sAw]Toge Productions Youtube Channel[/url], so you won't miss any future livestreams and announcement.

[previewyoutube=eOx5i1o9_4Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2] When the Past was Around is Now Available on Mobile Platform! [/h2]

A week ago, we released a teaser for When the Past was Around from our previous post. Now, you can play it for free on any mobile platform you have.

[previewyoutube=N1lxZYNYl9Q;full][/previewyoutube]

We are glad that the game now is more accessible for everyone, so do tell your friends and families to try out the game. Experience the bittersweet story of Mr. Owl and Eda with a slight finger tap, wherever you are~

You can use or share [url=https://linktr.ee/whenthepastwasaround]this main link[/url] which contains the latest information, freebies we gave out, and where to get When the Past was Around. 

Please stay safe and healthy, friends!

notes.title: When the Past was Around's First Anniversary!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, fellow lovebirds. [/h2]
It’s been exactly a year after the initial release of When the Past was Around here on Steam. Eda and Owl have been extremely blessed by your presence all year round. The game is extremely well-received by all of you, who are enjoying the game where all of us can connect together with Eda and Owl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/45f0fed2e8d99fb1ea6b76d23c82d5a6b8430f93.png[/img]
[i]Greetings from Mr. Owl and Eda by [url=https://twitter.com/crystalnyam/status/1440578380231954432]Rena[/url][/i]

[h2]A year worth of bittersweet journey. [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/1a465339bd3436db88df0c4d42ec73031fd09257.png[/img]
[i]Eda and Owl [url=https://twitter.com/togeproductions/status/1440571135716847622] 1st-anniversary illustration[/url] from Toge Productions[/i]

Our humble journey started [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1164050/announcements/detail/2896334282681838179]a year ago[/url], so many hardships we have gone through together. With the help from our friends, community, and you, we finally could realize the game into reality. Until now, we have been receiving so much love from the players who've experienced the bittersweet story of Eda and Owl. Does their story touch your heart?

[h2]Congrats to Elwin and Rena! [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/653fb5c1da22c8b9d9d5d103308c57cffd52c31b.png[/img]
[i]Elwin and Rena did an [url=https://twitter.com/crystalnyam/status/1427544646524162051]art collaboration[/url] for their wedding! [/i]

It's also been a good year for us, even in the midst of the pandemic, as Elwin and Rena also got married in August! Rena is the art director while Elwin is the game designer for the game. Congratulations to the lovebirds! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/bb6860cf6e9e2cf9982877071af349562fe8f10b.png[/img]

The love story between Eda and Owl is actually inspired by their story, did you know?

[h2]Our deepest gratitude to all of you![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/a7b33a687e2f0cf5d1c2a2d35146b09850c4be0d.png[/img]
[i][url=https://twitter.com/togeproductions/status/1440572093662261253]A huge thanks[/url] from Team Owl! [/i]

Team Owl also wants to deliver their deepest gratitude to all of our friends at Mojiken Studio, Toge Productions, and Chorus Worldwide! It is a great experience for all of us to work and meet with so many talented people. Owl and Eda really bring us together for this wholesome occasion. 

Once again, we want to say our heartfelt thanks to the players (which is you!) for being part of this fantastic journey of Eda and Owl. We hope to see you again soon!

Stay safe and healthy, friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/66643bb8ae0e6f02ad52c182224d9ae014d39591.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/01d050f3e5a3b796f2d5df411051cfc918f4c384.png[/img]

[h2]Interviewees - [/h2]
[b]Lantern Studio: LUNA The Shadow Dust[/b]
[b]George Eastmead[/b] - Community Manager 

[b]Mojiken Studio: When The Past Was Around[/b]
[b]Brigitta Rena[/b] - Art Director


[h2]What is your game about, and what does the player do in the game?[/h2]

[b]LUNA The Shadow Dust[/b]
LUNA The Shadow Dust is a hand-drawn point and click puzzle adventure game. Players control both characters to journey through a magical tower in search of the mysteries of old. Gameplay is joined together with a series of hand-animated wordless soundtracks in an emotional story with an original orchestral soundtrack. 

[b]When The Past Was Around[/b]
When the Past was Around tells the story of Eda, a girl who lost her way in the journey to achieve her dreams. Until she met The Owl. From this game, we could see how Eda found love and spark in her dream with Owl’s help, but after a brief time, Eda realized that Owl will not be there with her for long. It’s a bittersweet story about love, moving on, and letting go.
The game is a simple point-and-click puzzle game with beautiful hand-drawn art and classic music. A short silent narrative experience that can be finished in less than 2 hours.


[h2]What inspired the development of your game?[/h2]

[b]LUNA The Shadow Dust[/b]
Classic adventure games such as The Neverhood and Machinarium inspired the gameplay of LUNA The Shadow Dust. Thematically, the magical worlds of Ursula LeGuin novels and rich animation style of Studio Ghibli all played a huge part in the formation of the game. 

[b]When The Past Was Around[/b]
When the Past was Around is a work of fiction. At first, I’m not sure what kind of story happened between Eda and Owl. All I know is I want to make a bitter-sweet story. So, we discussed it with everyone's life experience in the studio, and the result is what you can see in the game!
Even though it is a work of fiction, somehow we put little details like Eda & Owl's favorite drinks, date spots, etc. from our own romance experience. What we’ve done with our partner, and how it feels to lose someone so dear to you.
Other than that, I take inspiration from many things I like, from games like Florence and Rusty Lake, from illustrator works like Puuung, Maori Sakai, and Yuko Higuchi, and from comic books like The Ancient Magus Bride and The Girl From The Other Side.


[h2]The Tales from the East bundle celebrates Asian game development. How did your team form?[/h2]

[b]LUNA The Shadow Dust[/b]
Lantern Studio is a four-person all-Chinese game dev team, with two of the group based in London and Toronto, respectively. Beidi Guo, the art director behind the game; met Fox, the project manager, back in high school and together formed the rest of the team bringing in Wang Qian, the composer and Wang Guan, the programmer who was previously working with Ubisoft at the time. 

[b]When The Past Was Around[/b]
It started in 2013 when a group of college friends from Indonesia decided to make their own game development studio. All of us majored in visual design so we had zero experience with game development, especially programming. So, we made our own internal game jam named Mojiken Camp to learn anything we needed to know from programming to marketing. This Mojiken Camp soon became something that we routinely do every two years.
Fast forward into 2019, we invited our audience to decide our next Mojiken Camp theme. The selected theme was “Future Memories”, and we formed small teams of 3-5 people to make small demos from this theme, one of the demos was “When the Past was Around”.


[h2]What themes or tropes from Asian culture are present in the game?[/h2]

[b]LUNA The Shadow Dust[/b]
The inspirations from Studio Ghibli animation are clearly apparent to most players of LUNA The Shadow Dust. Where many Asian productions present a balance between light and dark as a conflict between good and evil, LUNA looks to show this eternal struggle as a necessary conflict that helps form the intricacies of the world. 

[b]When The Past Was Around[/b]
We try our best to capture the modern culture and everyday life atmosphere in Indonesia nowadays. We made it kind of subtle, so players from wherever they live can still grasp the concept and relate to the story.
For some examples, we show the concept of a Kost, a long-term rented room that is usually found in Indonesia. We also showed some props and furniture that are familiar to Indonesian people like the shape of our post box, classic naco window, enamel mug, in both Eda and Owl fashion (my favorite was Eda’s white kebaya), and many other little details. This was inspired by how I love Japanese culture from furniture, tableware, to fashion. The aesthetic is in the little details so I want to show these details but in the Indonesian version.


[h2]What is unique about your game that differentiates it from similar other titles?[/h2]

[b]LUNA The Shadow Dust[/b]
Unlike many point and click games, LUNA avoids an inventory system and never forces you to backtrack from your location to solve a puzzle. The wordless narrative pushes the story forward and makes the game accessible to all cultures and languages. 

[b]When The Past Was Around[/b]
While there’s nothing unique in terms of theme and mechanics, When the Past was Around is something very precious and personal to us. The story of When the Past was Around was inspired by our story; Brigitta Rena the art director and Elwin the technical artist. Of course, with a tweak here and there. I think that this personal touch is what makes the game special and has a value of its own.
We also try our best to make this game without any dialogue. So the story is told with character gestures, environmental storytelling, and music. I hope that with this, people can interpret the story of When the Past was Around freely depending on their experience in relationship and life.


Play [b]Tales from the East[/b] bundle

notes.title: Nominate When the Past was Around for The Steam Awards!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/897bf51e520e06bdb00af153e690fe6ed6351eb2.png[/img]

Hello, everyone!
How are you? :)

Quick updates from When the Past was Around. We received over 600 reviews on Steam! Thank you so so sooooooo much! We also got over 1K followers now on our Twitter. So many things to celebrate!

We're reaching the end of 2020 (Is it just me or the time flies real fast this year?) and it's time for [b]The Steam Awards[/b]! And we're delighted to be able to have our game to hopefully be nominated this year.

We thought really hard on which category we want you to nominate us for. We were thinking whether we should go with Outstanding Visual Style or perhaps Sit Back & Relax? But we understand that a puzzle or two in our game is not... relaxing? Haha. So we decided to go with [b]Best Soundtrack[/b] category.

But again, if you think our game deserve to be nominated for different award and you have different game in mind that fits the Best Soundtrack category better, that is totally fine, too! :D But if you haven't decided, then please nominate When the Past was Around for the Best Soundtrack Award ;)

You can get the soundtrack here on Steam on listen to them on YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music, etc.

Oh! One last thing.
When the Past was Around is 20% off during Autumn Sale!

Ok, that's all. And as usual, please stay safe and stay healthy!
*sending virtual hugs to everyone*

notes.title: Minor Update - v1.0.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/cd8007f1f370249af828f1e6473ee6b27c5cfc8a.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing When the Past Was Around! We have received and acknowledged various issue regarding the game getting stuck in cutscenes. Our team have identified the bugs and we have pushed a new update (v1.0.2) with the fix.

We suspect that the cause of this issue is spamming mouseclicks during the cutscene process. If you encountered this issue, restarting the game and slowing down the clicks during cutscenes might fix it.

Also, if you still encounter the bug, it would be great if you can send your Player.log file to [i]info@togeproductions.com[/i] for us to check.

You can also reach out to us on Steam Discussions, Discord (discord.gg/toge), or our Social Media (twitter.com/WPWAgame)

notes.title: Devlog #03: Sneak Peek Video of the Full Game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/5fda0a80c3356d2f9c5b4b5d8018e2753daee3f1.png[/img]

[h1]Hello![/h1]

How are you? XD

Lately we’ve been joining lots of online events, so it’s pretty hectic for us these days. But we’re glad that we’ve been receiving lots of love, also from [b]Steam Game Festival: Summer Edition[/b] last month. Thanks to everyone who came and watched the stream!

Before the Steam Game Festival, we also participated in [i]Wholesome Direct[/i] where we showcased exclusive footage from the full game of [b]When the Past was Around[/b]. We thought maybe we can share the video we submitted here, too!

Check out the full-game footage on the video below!
https://youtu.be/ErAc0fK8DJU

And here’s the link to the full direct video.
https://youtu.be/AwCNzOPR8Ck?t=1088

Soooo… After watching the video, are you excited? Tell us in the comment section!

Oh, right! We also have some news from [b]When the Past was Around[/b]!
The game will be published in Japan by awesome team from Chorus Worldwide and they will also help us with the release and distribution on Nintendo Switch eShop, PS4, and Xbox One! So, yes! We’re coming to consoles as well! Yay yaaayyyy!

Last but not least, we finally have our own Twitter account!
So please follow us on Twitter! <3

TWITTER : http://twitter.com/WPWAgame

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/53cf9667bc7cd2d1324267c6a4dc2bbe83e9106c.png[/img]

[h1]Cross-Promo Time![/h1]

And please also wishlist this upcoming game from our studio, [b]A Space for the Unbound[/b]!
A slice-of-life adventure game set in the late 90s rural Indonesia that tells a story about overcoming anxiety, depression, and the relationship between a boy and a girl with supernatural powers.

If you love When the Past was Around, you will probably love this game, too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201270/A_Space_For_The_Unbound/

notes.title: Devlog: Early Concept Sketches
notes.content:
Hello again!

Hope everyone is doing well.

On this devlog, we will be sharing early concept sketches that you’ll see in the game and the one you will not see as well :p

[h2]Kota Tua[/h2]
These are the early concept sketches for the city scene on[b] When The Past Was Around[/b]. To bring out a melancholic atmosphere, we took some architectural references from Surabaya “Kota Tua” district. “Kota Tua” lliterally means old city. Also, we use lots of Indonesian-Dutch Colonial ornamental and architectural influences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36045652/43d232d636d68e925d131c2b52c82203cf254d60.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36045652/99d05c6025445a4fe3428812503d5e53b9d782ff.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36045652/1f0f1c2ad9857643bf8a40416fe0c9bfef6d06a5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Plants[/h2]
If you’ve been with us since [i]A Raven Monologue[/i] and [i]She and the Light Bearer,[/i] you’ll know that I love plants so much. I just can’t help but put as many plants as possible in every environment. Even the city got its own garden!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36045652/c4a0df66ac419f1850fcfec2969b013e731ce3da.jpg[/img]

You'll find lots of plants and foliage later almost everywhere in the game, so be prepared for that XD

[h2]Scrap[/h2]
Last but not least, here’s the sketch of unused puzzles and environments. This is an exclusive content because you won’t find this in the game hehe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36045652/a3ab93604976d527f641f0e85d1dc790dd6c7edc.jpg[/img]

- - - - -

That’s all!

Please let me know if there’s anything you want me to share on the next devlog. I’d be happy to share them with all of you :) And if you want to see more sketches, please follow me on Twitter here: [url=http://twitter.com/crystalnyam]twitter.com/crystalnyam[/url]

And don't forget to wishlist the game!

With love,
Rena and Owl Team

notes.title: Devlog: Sharing the Progress on Edda and Owl
notes.content:
Hello! 

This is probably our very first devlog. We want to share a bit on the progress of [b]When the Past was Around[/b].

[h1]April is Here![/h1]
Oh, in case you’re here from Twitter, Happy April Fool’s Day!

And thank you to our friends from [b]Rusty Lake[/b] for letting us collaborate with their latest game, [b]The White Door[/b] for this April Fool’s joke. Anyway, their game is very awesome! If you love point-and-click game, do check out their Steam page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145960/The_White_Door/

Back to When the Past was Around now!

[h1]How are Edda and Owl?[/h1]
So far, we have mostly done with the level design for all the chapters of the game. Now we are on the polishing state. We’re trying to finish the art for all characters, adding some sequences, and working on other cosmetic stuff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/2afdf794f2bc7de10eac98bc474c7fcf4a819b0c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/b920255bbd363160671d1187de5e86a2a7114902.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/e2665cd571438beb6d29756e070cac2c215044ae.png[/img]

See the video below for a full preview of the cityscape art!

https://youtu.be/W2VJc1Jwfjs

Work became a little harder for us since the team is now working from home because of the COVID-19 issue and internet speed here sucks. But, no matter how much difficulty we’re having, we’re still doing well and we’re trying to stay healthy, both physically and mentally. And we know people out there, including you, are also having a difficult time due to this pandemic.

We hope you all are doing great wherever you are! Thank you for all of your support until now and I hope we could deliver Edda and Owl’s story with the best of our capability.


Stay safe, everyone!


WIth love,
Owl Team
